richiami.difetto: The front entrance door heated glass may spontaneously shatter with the consequence that persons may be hit by fragments of glass.
richiami.rimedio: Operators of affected vehicles will be contacted and instructed to remove the fuse from the electrical circuit of the relevant heater element.
richiami.titolo: ENTRANCE DOOR HEATED GLASS COULD SPONTANEOUSLY SHATTER
